summary: Reviewed i18n key additions in en.json and uk.json for task 4 of 06-bot-connection. The change is data-only (translation strings, no executable code). All five task-specific security checks pass: (1) errors.bot.connect.409 is generic in both locales and does not name a foreign project, owner email, or identifier; (2) errors.bot.connect.500 is the generic 'Webhook configuration error — contact support' wording with no Telegram API description leaked; (3) no 401 key exists under errors.bot.* — the few 401 keys in the files are scoped to errors.auth.*, errors.projects.*, errors.users.* (pre-existing, out of scope); (4) no bot tokens, secrets, API keys, URLs, or sensitive identifiers are hardcoded — only public BotFather references (@BotFather, /newbot) which are documented public Telegram conventions; (5) the only interpolation placeholder in the bot namespace is the named curly-brace placeholder {username} in bot.disconnect.modal.body, which vue-i18n auto-escapes by default — no v-html sink involved in JSON strings. No OWASP Top 10 concerns (no injection sinks, no auth/authz logic, no crypto, no SSRF surface, no deserialization, no logging gaps introduced by translation strings). No information disclosure, no enumeration vectors. Approved.
